task.question: On what date does the live-action One Piece Season 2 premiere on Netflix?
task.evidence: The second season was released on March 10, 2026. Like the first season, it consists of eight episodes.

answer:
The live-action One Piece Season 2 premieres on Netflix on March 10, 2026.

[What's next for Jayden Daniels, Commanders after elbow injury?] play How should the Commanders handle another Jayden Daniels injury? (2:07) ARLINGTON, Texas -- For nearly an entire half on Sunday, Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels resembled the player from 2024, the one who was named NFL Offensive Rookie of the Year and mentioned as a future league MVP. On the final drive of the first half at the Dallas Cowboys , Daniels provided reminders of that season: He ran for 24 yards and threw for another 27, including a strike on third-and-6 to Stefon Diggs for 10 yards. Then, on the final play of the half, the 2025 version of Daniels showed up, the one who missed 10 games with three different injuries. He suffered a dislocated left elbow, leaving the Commanders with plenty of questions about the future -- from his durability to whether they had built a good enough roster to withstand his absence for even a short period. Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Daniels will visit specialists Tuesday and Wednesday to determine the best course of action. It's the same injury Daniels sustained in Week 9 last season; he returned in Week 14, but after reinjuring the elbow in that contest, the Commanders shut him down for the final four games of the campaign. His latest injury has left Washington in a familiar spot: wondering what this means for Daniels' future and trying to piece together wins. Last season, the Commanders struggled to do the latter and finished 5-12. Washington is 0-2 now and will face the defending Super Bowl champion Seattle Seahawks in its home opener Sunday. "0-2 is not where we wanted to be, that's for sure," Quinn said. "But we also are resolute that that's not where we're going to be staying." Commanders reporter John Keim and senior fantasy writer Eric Karabell weigh in on Daniels' latest injury and what it means for him, the Commanders and their collective futures. [One Piece (2023 TV series) season 2] The second season of the American fantasy adventure television series One Piece, marketed as Into the Grand Line, based on the manga of the same name written by Eiichiro Oda, was developed for television by Matt Owens and Joe Tracz. The season was produced by Kaji Productions and Shueisha. The season stars Iñaki Godoy, Emily Rudd, Mackenyu, Jacob Romero Gibson, Taz Skylar, Charithra Chandran, and Mikaela Hoover. In the season, Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates embark on their journey across the Grand Line while facing off against an organization of assassins called Baroque Works. The season released on the streaming service Netflix on March 10, 2026.
